caption: Lecce Baroque center, Lecce
composition: Honey-stone Baroque façades on a quiet piazza · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist faces the honey-stone splendor of Lecce's Baroque front, where an exuberantly carved church facade fills the right of the frame with its scrolled gables and sculpted portal. A stately palazzo runs along the center-left above the empty paved piazza, and a lone tree stands at the far left edge. The 07:24 light is soft and rosy, gilding the carved stonework under a pale morning sky.
